newsitem.title: JAPAN: Renown Inc up on signs of better earnings.
newsitem.headline: Renown Inc up on signs of better earnings.

text.p: Renown Inc's shares rose in Tuesday afternoon trade after it released earnings results showing that its business was slowly improving, brokers said.
By 0441 GMT, the clothing manufacturer's shares had climbed 27 yen to 244. Renown was also the second largest percentage gainer on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.
Renown said its sales grew to 191.99 billion yen in the year to January 31, 1997, compared with 189.89 billion yen in the previous year.
It also said its parent current loss had shrunk to 4.82 billion yen from the 11.55 billion posted in the previous year.
